messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "thoughts about suicide"
set: ["thoughts about suicide", "having thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "some people have thoughts about suicide", "report thoughts about suicide to your doctor", "some young people have thoughts about suicide", "people with depression or mental illness may have thoughts about suicide", "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant", "having thoughts about hurting yourself", "unusual mood changes, thoughts about hurting yourself", "tell your healthcare provider about new or worsening depression, mood changes, or thoughts of suicide or self-harm", "some young people up to 24 years of age have thoughts about suicide when first taking this medicine", "report thoughts about hurting yourself to your doctor", "suicidal thoughts", "racing thoughts", "tell your doctor right away if you have any sudden changes in mood or behavior or thoughts about suicide"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "having thoughts about suicide",
    "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide",
    "some people have thoughts about suicide",
    "report thoughts about suicide to your doctor",
    "some young people have thoughts about suicide",
    "people with depression or mental illness may have thoughts about suicide",
    "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant",
    "some young people up to 24 years of age have thoughts about suicide when first taking this medicine",
    "suicidal thoughts",
    "report thoughts about hurting yourself to your doctor",
    "tell your doctor right away if you have any sudden changes in mood or behavior or thoughts about suicide"
  ],
  "alias": "thoughts about suicide"
}
